notes.title: The Experiment begins!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890626/66a772c56146ce4b6a3a5ae85e77988bcfa1a61b.png

Hello and welcome to The Experiment!!

The Experiment is a multiplayer escape room puzzle game for virtual reality or desktop PC! You took part in an experiment that went out of control, you wake up in what looks like a doctor's office, but thankfully the doctor is missing. This is your chance to escape before they come back!

Will you be fast enough?

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
